##: Scoop manifest for the eordano/scoop-bucket bucket.
The hash here is a placeholder: this file is a template, and a release's
digests do not exist until it is built. The Release workflow renders a
-- and after the first publish Scoop's own autoupdate takes over: run
'bin/checkver.ps1 tokencount -u' in the bucket checkout, which follows
checkver to the newest release and pulls the digest out of SHA256SUMS.
Never paste a hash by hand.
The executable links the CRT statically (-C target-feature=+crt-static in
the release workflow), so no Visual C++ redistributable is needed.
Only x64 is published. Windows 11 on ARM runs the x64 build under
emulation, but Scoop will not install a 64bit-only manifest on an arm64
host, so ARM users should take packaging/install.ps1 instead.
description: Lightning-fast offline token counter for 9 LLM tokenizers
notes: tokencount is a single self-contained executable -- all nine tokenizer
tables are compiled into it, so there are no runtime data files.
